lines.text: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to anger, because man's anger does not bring God's righteousness.
James tells his brothers to get rid of moral filth and humbly accept the word planted in them, which can save their souls.
Hearers only deceive themselves, like a man who looks in a mirror and then immediately forgets what he looks like.
The one who looks intently into the perfect law of freedom and keeps at it will be blessed in what he knows.
Pure religion is to care for prophets and widows in their distress and to keep oneself unpolluted by the world.
